messages:
emi: Quick bug report — the /v1/generate docs use `model` in the OpenAPI example but the curl quickstart and Go snippet still send `model_id` in the JSON body. New users hitting the quickstart get a 400.

frank: ugh, thanks. Which files are out of sync?

emi: docs/api/generate.md, docs/samples/generate_example.json, snippets/go/generate_quickstart.md.

rachel: We agreed last quarter to standardize on `model` (query param or body field). Let's normalize examples to `model` and keep `model_id` in a legacy note.

ci-bot: CI: sample validator error docs/samples/generate_example.json line 15: type mismatch for `temperature` (string vs number).

frank: I'll change the Go and curl snippets to use `model` and fix the temperature to 0.2 (number). Will also add a short migration note: "If you currently use `model_id`, switch to `model`; runtime accepts both for now."

emi: Please push a wip branch and ping me for review — this blocks the quickstart smoke test.

frank: Pushed branch `docs/fix/generate-model-param-3823456789` with commits `normalize-model-param` and `sample-type-fix`. Opening PR now and requesting review from @emi.

ci-bot: Preview build queued.

emi: Reviewing — looks good. Once CI passes, merge and add a one-line changelog entry.

ci-bot: Preview build passed.

frank: Merged and added changelog: "docs: standardize generate endpoint examples to use `model`; fix sample types"

emi: Verified quickstart curl works in preview. Closing thread.
